Self.Wiki: This map object represents an in-game object of varying sizes, from clutter to cliffs. Supports in-built collision, however not all objects use it.

Asset_Unk00.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 291 retail assets.

Asset_Unk01.Wiki: Read by the game. 0, or 25 on about 2,000 assets.

Asset_Unk04.Wiki: Read by the game. -1 on all but two retail assets (1 and 2).

Asset_Unk10.Wiki: Read by the game. 0, or 3 on 8 assets.

Asset_Unk12.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 41 retail assets.

Asset_Unk13.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 93 retail assets.

AssetSfxParamRelativeID.Wiki: The SFX ID for this object to use (added to the base ModelSfxParam ID). -1 for none.

DisplayGroupSourcePartNames.Wiki: A part whose display groups this asset takes at map load: the second entry if set, else the first. Ignored when the asset's Keep Own Display Groups is on. Set on 19 retail assets.

PartNames.Wiki: Parts linked to the asset, in pairs (the second of a pair is used if set, else the first). The third and fourth name the asset's collision: where the asset's own collision settings are off, it uses that collision's values (see the structs below).

Asset_Unk44.Wiki: Read by the game. -1, or 999 on 25 assets.

Asset_TalkID.Wiki: Not found read by the game. 0, or 560-564 on 15 assets.

Asset_Unk4C.Wiki: An unknown flag read by the game. On for 151 retail assets.

Asset_Unk4E.Wiki: The first of three values the game reads as a list (with 0x50 and 0x52). -1, or 0 on 29 assets.

Asset_Unk50.Wiki: The second value of the 0x4E list. -1, or 0 on 9 assets.

Asset_Unk52.Wiki: The third value of the 0x4E list. -1, or 0 on 9 assets.

Asset_Unk54.Wiki: Read by the game. 0, or a single bit (1, 4, 8 ... 32768) on 23 assets.

UnkAssetStruct60.Wiki: The asset's own copies of some collision values. Used when Override is on; otherwise the game takes them from the asset's collision.

AssetStruct60_Unk00.Wiki: If ON, the values of this struct are used instead of the collision's. On for about 1,900 retail assets.

AssetStruct60_Unk04.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x26 flag.

UnkAssetStruct68.Wiki: The asset's own light set override; in retail never used.

UnkAssetStruct70.Wiki: The asset's own copy of the collision's Unknown: 0x4 value. Used when Override is on; otherwise the game takes it from the asset's collision.

AssetStruct70_Unk00.Wiki: If ON, the value below is used instead of the collision's. On for 109 retail assets.

AssetStruct70_Unk04.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x4.

UnkAssetStruct78.Wiki: The asset's own copies of the collision's Unknown: 0x1 and 0x2. Used when Override is on; otherwise the game takes them from the asset's collision.

AssetStruct78_Unk00.Wiki: If ON, the values below are used instead of the collision's. On for 132 retail assets.

AssetStruct78_Unk01.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x1.

AssetStruct78_Unk02.Wiki: The asset's own value of the collision's Unknown: 0x2.
